_comment: Fictional dates for the lab, the one program-dates file Chapters 03 and 06 both read. In a real run the identity engineering lead copies them from the program master schedule: D08 (end dates for legacy authentication and NTLM) is when the program records the end date of every account that stays on Kerberos, and bounds none (WD-165); G5 (AD retired) bounds that end date, or the island's end of life where D11 keeps a Kerberos island (NP3.6, NP7.3); D11 is the provisional target end state set at G0 (AdRetired, or KerberosIsland with an end-of-life date), which Chapter 06 reconciles every gMSA and dMSA against. Chapter 06 refuses a copy whose SHA-256 isn't the one Chapter 03's run recorded.
